case: Direct query distinctness parameters on a three-level domain-over-enum column
change: Extend the three-level domain chain contract with inferred direct query parameters for IS DISTINCT FROM and IS NOT DISTINCT FROM, using both text labels and SQL NULL.
contract: PostgreSQL infers each bound parameter as the qualified leaf enum without an explicit cast on the parameter.
The queried column retains its outer three-level domain type.
All per-row truth values distinguish the literal enum label NULL, an empty label, a Unicode label and SQL NULL.
independent_oracle: PostgreSQL pg_typeof($1), pg_typeof(status) and exact server boolean results for all four fixture rows.
